title: The Lighthouse Keeper's Daughter
subtitle: A Cornish Coast Mystery
author: Mara Ellison
description:
The lamp has burned every night for forty years. Tonight it is dark.

Cornwall, 1887. Tamsin Pascoe has spent her life in the shadow of Porthcarrow Light, trimming wicks and logging ships beside a father who trusts the sea more than people. When she wakes to a cold lantern room, he is gone, and a stranger lies drowned on the rocks below with her father's watch in his pocket.

The village is quick to decide what that means. The coastguard wants a culprit, the mine owner wants the headland, and the one man offering Tamsin help arrived on the same tide as the body.

To find her father she must read the things he never said aloud: a second logbook, a signal no keeper is taught, and a debt older than she is. Each answer brings her closer to him, and to the reason he ran.

A slow-burning historical mystery of family loyalty, wreckers and the cost of keeping a light.
